product_family: Lindy is an AI executive assistant SaaS platform that automates email triage, meeting scheduling, note-taking, and task management via iMessage/SMS. Available in free (7-day trial), Plus ($49.99/month), and Enterprise (custom pricing with SSO/SCIM/BAA) tiers.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2 Type II, independently audited by Johanson Group

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: HIPAA security controls mapped to requirements. Enterprise tier includes HIPAA Compliant and signed BAA

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: GDPR compliance validates operational effectiveness of security controls. Data Processing section in Terms establishes processor obligations under GDPR.

certifications.name: PIPEDA
certifications.proof_quote: PIPEDA compliance is verified through regular testing

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence of ISO 27001 certification found; vendor security page lists SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, PIPEDA but not ISO 27001

privacy.ai_training_note: Vendor explicitly states: 'your personal information will never be transferred, delivered, or made available to or otherwise used to train a generative AI product.' However, Terms of Service grant Lindy rights to use submissions for 'analytics purposes in perpetuity'; the scope of this clause relative to AI model training is not explicitly clarified.
privacy.data_region: Multi-region (Digital Ocean, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud); EU data processing via GDPR-compliant mechanisms

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: AES encryption; all data moving in/out encrypted

security.name: Access Control
security.value: User-controlled, revocable permissions with all actions logged for visibility

security.name: Infrastructure
security.value: Enterprise-grade cloud infrastructure with hardened access controls

security.name: Monitoring & Response
security.value: Real-time monitoring, regular vulnerability scans, defined incident response procedures

security.name: Data Protection Officer
security.value: Luiz Scheidegger (DPO designated); Non-EU Representative: Florent Crivello

products.name: Lindy Free
products.data_scope: Up to 1 inbox, basic features (email drafting, meeting scheduling, meeting notes)
products.notes: 7-day free trial, then paid tiers required. Limited data scope and features.

products.name: Lindy Plus
products.data_scope: Up to 2 inboxes, 100+ integrations, email triage, meeting scheduling, meeting prep & follow-up
products.notes: $49.99/month. Standard SaaS offering for individuals and small teams. No BAA or HIPAA compliance explicitly required at this tier.

products.name: Lindy Enterprise
products.data_scope: Expanded usage, team settings, full audit logging
products.notes: Custom pricing. Includes SSO, SCIM, Audit logs, HIPAA Compliant with signed BAA, Dedicated support, Onboarding and enablement. Purpose-built for regulated environments and large organizations.

compare.data_residency: Multi-region cloud (Digital Ocean, Azure, Google Cloud); GDPR-compliant EU data handling available
top_certs: HIPAA (with signed BAA on Enterprise tier)

flags: ISO 27001 is not claimed or publicly documented; vendor focuses on SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, and PIPEDA.

AI training clause: Privacy policy explicitly excludes customer data from AI training. However, Terms of Service include a broad 'analytics purposes in perpetuity' clause for user submissions. The boundary between 'analytics' and 'model training' is not explicitly defined; buyers should seek clarification during procurement.
HIPAA compliance is available only on the Enterprise tier with a signed BAA; consumers on the Plus tier are not HIPAA-covered.
No explicit mention of data residency choice (EU vs. US). Multi-region default; unclear if customers can request EU-only data processing without explicit agreement with vendor.
